thought.text: The apt install timed out. Let me check its state:

reasoning_content: The apt install timed out at 600 seconds. Let me check the current state of the JDK installation.

action.command: ls /usr/lib/jvm/ 2>/dev/null; echo "---install log tail---"; tail -5 /tmp/jdk-install.log 2>/dev/null; echo "---is apt still running?---"; ps aux | grep -E "apt|dpkg" | grep -v grep | head
